subject: Sector Briefing: Executive Salon — final guest sequencing, venue addendum & NDA
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@velvetvenues.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sector Briefing: Executive Salon — final guest sequencing, venue addendum & NDA

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for holding the 2nd-floor private salon on Oct 21 for our CFO guests. We're in final sequencing and I want to confirm a few operational items before we send the official invitations this week. Quick asks: 

- Can you confirm the signed venue addendum (NDAs for venue staff + one-page confidentiality rider) can be executed by next Wednesday 9/21? We need venue staff NDA language for our procurement checklist.
- Confirm the buyout window (6:30–9:30pm) and whether we can have the foyer for a 30-minute cocktail reception at 6:00pm for arrivals.
- Any last-minute menu constraints (dietary/cross-contam warnings) we should surface on invites?

Attached: guest_list_v2.xlsx (working invite sequencing + priority tiers).

If you can get the DocuSign link for the addendum to me, Marissa will finalize the invite send cadence.

Appreciate it —

Diego Fernández
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
 diego@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Rossi <elena@velvetvenues.co>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <thargreaves@acme-enterprises.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sector Briefing: Executive Salon — final guest sequencing, venue addendum & NDA

Diego —

Great to hear — happy to lock this down. Quick updates: 

- We can do a private buyout for the 2nd floor 6:00pm–10:00pm (cocktail foyer from 6:00–6:30pm as requested). We will staff a dedicated concierge and two floor managers.
- I attached the latest venue agreement with the addendum language (VelvetVenue_Agreement_v3.pdf). There is a standard clause for staff confidentiality; I highlighted a one-sentence confidentiality rider we can add for your legal team. If you want faster turnaround, I can prepare a DocuSign envelope for the rider only.
- Catering notes: chef needs confirmed counts by 10/14; they can accommodate vegetarian, pescatarian, and halal; severe allergen handling (tree nuts) requires a separate plated option we can label.
- Insurance: we require attendee cap endorsement and vendor insurance — I attached our requirements (venue_req_insurance.pdf).

If Laura's team wants to review redlines, let me know and I'll route the rider via DocuSign today.

Best,
Elena Rossi
VP, Events — Velvet Venues
Elena@velvetvenues.co
Attachment: VelvetVenue_Agreement_v3.pdf
Attachment: venue_req_insurance.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sector Briefing: Executive Salon — final guest sequencing, venue addendum & NDA

On Tue, Sep 14, 2027 at 09:49, Elena Rossi <elena@velvetvenues.co> wrote:
> We can do a private buyout for the 2nd floor 6:00pm–10:00pm (cocktail foyer from 6:00–6:30pm as requested).

Perfect — thanks Elena.

Diego / Ben / Laura: proposed invite plan from the attached guest_list_v2.xlsx: 
- Week of 9/20: soft save-the-date to Tier A (10 names) with an ask for dietary restrictions.
- Week of 9/27: formal invite to Tier B + final count stub.
- Week of 10/11: final reminder + logistics.

Ben — can you confirm we have flexibility in the hospitality budget to add a plated nut-free option (per Elena) and a taxi stipend for 3 priority guests?
Laura — please review the highlighted rider in VelvetVenue_Agreement_v3.pdf; if you approve, ask Elena to send DocuSign for signature by 9/21.

I'll draft the short invite copy once we have the signed rider.

—Marissa
Sr. Events Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernández <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sector Briefing: Executive Salon — budget/insurance check

Forwarding Elena's attachments to procurement and legal.

Marissa / Laura — quick answers: 
- Hospitality budget: we can cover up to 3 taxi stipends and the plated nut-free option within the current line if we ingest it as a line-item contingency (~$1,200).
- Insurance: procurement notes the venue_req_insurance.pdf is standard; we'll coordinate the certificate of insurance from our broker after signatures. Expect a 3–5 business day turnaround for COI.

I'll mark the budget as approved pending signed rider.

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: venue_req_insurance.pdf

From: Elena Rossi <elena@velvetvenues.co>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <thargreaves@acme-enterprises.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sector Briefing: Executive Salon — final guest sequencing, venue addendum & NDA

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks all — rider is in DocuSign now: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-id-76328. If Laura's legal team signs by 9/21 we'll be good to go for the final invite send cadence. I've attached the signed venue addendum template once completed as a PDF.

Final logistics note for your invites: we can offer a limited valet allocation (12 spots) and a nearby overflow lot (pay by app) — suggest we include a short line in the logistics note.

I'll watch for the signature and COI.

Warmly,
Elena Rossi
VP, Events — Velvet Venues
Attachment: signed_venue_addendum_docusign.pdf

From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sector Briefing: Executive Salon — final guest sequencing, venue addendum & NDA

(Internal note) All set — Marissa will proceed with the Tier A soft-save on 9/20 once Laura confirms signature. Ben — thanks for budget sign-off; include the plated option and 3 taxi stipends in the PO.

I'll update the guest_list_v2.xlsx with the valet/overflow callouts and circulate final invite copy by EOD Friday.

Diego
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
